criteria: Direct human molecular measurements connected to a defined meditation or mindfulness intervention; retain null findings and clearly label observational designs.
Clinical RCTs selected for sample size, active comparators, prespecified outcomes, relevance to anxiety/PTSD/depression and informative null findings. No blanket high-quality label before appraisal.
Do not count secondary publications as independent trials.
No Jadad scores inferred from study design, topic crosses or abstract alone.
